newsitem.title: USA: Valley Resources to offer stock, debt.
newsitem.headline: Valley Resources to offer stock, debt.

text.p: Holding company Valley Resources Inc said it had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of 620,000 common shares and $7.0 million of debentures due 2027.
The company said in a statement it offered underwriters Edward D. Jones LLP and First Albany Corp an option to purchase an extra 93,000 shares to cover any over-allotments.
It said it would use the net proceeds of the stock offering to retire a portion of the outstanding short-term debt held by its utility operations.
The company said it would use the proceeds from its debt offering to make loans to the subsidiary operations to retire a portion of their short-term debt.

Valley Resources has more than 4.2 million shares in circulation. It owns subsidiaries in natural gas distribution; retail propane gas sales and services; merchandise sales and services; and wholesale distribution of franchised lines.
It also has an 80-percent interest in Alternate Energy Corp, which converts traditionally-fuelled vehicles to natural gas, among other services.
